shellCommands.command: cat /workspace/package.json && ls /workspace
ls /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/ 2>/dev/null | head -50
grep -rli "viewtransition\|view-transition\|view transition" node_modules/next/dist/docs/ | head -30
find app lib -type f | head -60 && echo "---" && cat next.config.ts

sed -n '1,80p' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md; echo "=== transitionTypes section ==="; awk '/transitionTypes/,0' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -80

grep -n -i "viewtransition\|view transition\|transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/upgrading/version-16.md node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/02-guides/interactive-apps.md | head -40
awk '/^### `transitionTypes`/,/^### /{print}' node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | head -60

grep -rn "viewTransition" node_modules/next/dist/server/config-schema.d.ts node_modules/next/dist/server/config-shared.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "--- react version ---"; node -e "console.log(require('/workspace/node_modules/react/package.json').version)"; echo "--- ViewTransition export ---"; node -e "const R=require('/workspace/node_modules/react'); console.log('ViewTransition' in R, typeof R.ViewTransition)"

grep -n "transitionTypes" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md; echo "=== context ==="; L=$(grep -n "^### \`transitionTypes\`" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md | cut -d: -f1); sed -n "${L},$((L+45))p" node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/02-components/link.md

grep -rn "ViewTransition" node_modules/@types/react/*.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== types/react version ==="; node -e "console.log(require('/workspace/node_modules/@types/react/package.json').version)"; echo "=== tsconfig ==="; cat /workspace/tsconfig.json
cat /workspace/next-env.d.ts 2>/dev/null || echo "NO next-env.d.ts"; echo "=== canary.d.ts head ==="; sed -n '1,40p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts
sed -n '35,120p' node_modules/@types/react/canary.d.ts
ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__ 2>/dev/null && find /workspace/__agent_eval__ -type f | head -20
npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -40
npx next build 2>&1 | tail -35

(npx next start -p 3111 > /tmp/next.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 6; echo "--- HOME grid image markup ---"; curl -s localhost:3111/ | grep -o 'class="product-image[^>]*>' | head -4; echo "--- DETAIL hero markup ---"; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o '<div[^>]*product-hero[^>]*>' | head -2

echo "--- page-level wrapper (home <main>) ---"; curl -s localhost:3111/ | grep -o '<main[^>]*>' ; echo "--- detail page wrapper + back link ---"; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o '<div vt-[^>]*>' | head -2; curl -s localhost:3111/product/classic-sneakers | grep -o '<a[^>]*back-link[^>]*>'; echo "--- CSS: view transition rules shipped ---"; CSS=$(curl -s localhost:3111/ | grep -o '/_next/static/[^"]*\.css' | head -1); echo "file: $CSS"; curl -s "localhost:3111$CSS" | grep -c "view-transition"; curl -s "localhost:3111$CSS" | grep -o "prefers-reduced-motion[^{]*"

CSS=$(curl -s localhost:3111/ | grep -o '/_next/static/[^"]*\.css' | head -1); B=$(curl -s "localhost:3111$CSS"); echo "view-transition pseudo count: $(printf '%s' "$B" | grep -o '::view-transition' | wc -l)"; echo "--- classes referenced ---"; printf '%s' "$B" | grep -o '::view-transition-[a-z-]*(\.\?[a-z-]*)' | sort -u; echo "--- keyframes ---"; printf '%s' "$B" | grep -o '@keyframes [a-z-]*' | sort -u

grep -o 'vt-enter\|vt-exit\|vt-share\|vt-update\|vt-name' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-server.edge.production.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u; echo "--- client handling ---"; grep -o 'vt-enter\|vt-exit' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/compiled/react-dom/cjs/react-dom-client.production.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u

ls /root/.cache/ms-playwright /home/vercel-sandbox/.cache/ms-playwright 2>/dev/null; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome google-chrome-stable 2>/dev/null; node -e "try{require.resolve('playwright');console.log('playwright resolvable')}catch(e){console.log('no playwright')}"

grep -ro "transitionTypes" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/link.js /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/*.js 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head; echo "--- addTransitionType wiring ---"; grep -rno "addTransitionType" /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/*.js /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/app-dir/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -5
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; sed -n '210,222p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-instance.js
sed -n '208,222p' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/client/components/app-router-instance.js; echo "=== diff ==="; git --no-pager diff --stat && git status --short
git --no-pager diff tsconfig.json package.json
rm -f /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -20 && rm -f /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; echo "typecheck exit: ok"; git --no-pager diff --stat tsconfig.json
npx tsc --noEmit && rm -f tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && echo "TYPECHECK OK" && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -12
rm -f /workspace/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo; git --no-pager diff -- app lib
